en.intro: This melamine plate shows Opanchu Usagi in a cute Chinese-style look and is made for serving fried rice at home. After you order, FeelBetter buys it from Perfect World Tokyo in Japan and ships it to you.
highlights: Opanchu Usagi appears in a cute Chinese-style look, which makes meals at home a little more fun.
It is made of melamine resin, so it is light and sturdy.
It is dishwasher safe, which keeps cleaning up easy.
It measures 18.5 x 18.5 x 3.8 cm, a size made for a serving of fried rice.
According to the source listing, the same series also has a gyoza plate and a ramen bowl.

sections.p: Serve fried rice on a plate that brings Opanchu Usagi to your table at home. The melamine is light to carry and sturdy for daily use, and the plate can go in the dishwasher.

The plate measures 18.5 x 18.5 x 3.8 cm (about 7.3 x 7.3 x 1.5 in) and is made of melamine resin. The source listing notes that the same series also has a gyoza plate and a ramen bowl; if you are interested, ask our concierge on the request page.

cautions: The plate measures 18.5 x 18.5 x 3.8 cm; please check that this size suits your servings.
